notes.title: Patch notes Apr 7th 2024
notes.content:
Minor patch to correct some visuals, grammar errors, and several events.

Boat is now not accessible as intended, after completing the maelstrom. 
Previously, boat was not relocated and allowed player to sail back into the maelstrom after completion.

Several timers were extended by a second to allow a smoother transition into scenes when zoning into a new map.

Several monsters experience and gold drops were increased along with change/reduction in the Shroomling's chance to flee combat.

I'll be attempting to make a mobile version of game and will put out announcements when it's available for testing. If you are interested in being a tester then let me know!

Until then....
Have fun and Game On!
-Eric

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.content: During my recent playthrough of Ericanskinsmonsters I noticed something which was conflicting with the lighting in certain dark maps.  Goblin/Dwarf mine, spider caves, and all buildings using that lighting should all be corrected and showing a darkened atmosphere with lantern lighting.

notes.title: Update "bug fix"
notes.content:
I located the conflicting triggers which caused the despawn of the western forest mini bosses after interacting with the statue in the middle of the western maze. Now the forest guardians will spawn at the center fountain and then teleport to their hiding spots after dialog, as intended. When "Lucy" joins the party in the eastern part of the forest, she activated a trigger which caused the issue. This has been corrected and completely new triggers were assigned in order to eliminate any conflict. If you were experiencing this issue, load a save file sometime before meeting Lucy. I appreciate your patience and feedback, thank you. Game On!
Eric

notes.title: Minor bug fixes!
notes.content:
I hope everyone had a great holiday. This patch just corrected a few things that I noticed while playing through the game. Below are the following fixes.
- set shovel/church key/woodcutter's axe to be shown only in menu
- corrected some dialog in scenes
- fixed bug where when you back out of attempting the tower of trials using the save point before the boss, you now get teleported to the first room invisible and teleported back right away. Player should now be teleported back to the world map outside the dungeon and upon returning to the dungeon, they will be teleported back to the bottom floor.
- fixed the bug where if you back out of dialog and leave the bottom floor of the tower of trials. Party should no longer be visible at the orb sealing the gate, until you reactivate the event.
- more notification sound effects added to a scene where player receives rewards.

notes.title: Lvl 99 Update & Quick fix patch
notes.content:
I began another play through after launch and I happened to noticed some things that I wanted fixed as soon as possible and while doing so, I noticed a post of someone wishing there was more than 20 players lvls. Poof lvl 99 is the max lvl, but please do not feel you need to grind to enjoy this game if that is not your thing. If you are strategic in using counters to the mobs or have located the powerful hidden weapons/armor or purchased end game gear at merchants within the towns then you should be able to complete the game without grinding. This game has tons of hidden treasure chest/weapons/armor/gold/items and even some mobs/bosses drop great gear you can access through exploring dungeons/maps! Some players may enjoy to fight more encounters than others and get caught up in vibing to the music, and I certainly won't hinder players from enjoying the game the way they like it.... as long as it does not deter from the game. This patch swapped max lvl of players from 20 to 99 for all characters and Drippy(your summoned flesh golem) His max lvl is set from 9 to lvl 30 because he is already designed to be OP, due to summoning requirements. In doing this I had to do mx to accommodate the lvl changes in one of the zones. Fairy/dryad/pixie in western elven forest should now reappear where they are hiding instead of reappearing back at fountain when players leave the zone before slaying them. Typo corrections which were noticed are corrected. Sound effects for attacking with shields were slightly adjusted. Cleave mechanic on one of the spectral skeletons was swapped to the correct cleave.  Ghost in the breach at the bottom of the tower of trials had a boss encounter event within it....I swapped it to a ghost encounter. I added collisions to large holes and a few other terrains, so you can't just walk over them. I will continue to support this game with updates in regards to bugs/balancing combat/and exploring ways to maybe alter the challenge difficulty. I hope this brings a smile to the gamers who were really hoping for more character levels in this game! I wish everyone happy holidays and thank you for your time! 
-Eric (dev for SmirkSmileGrin Games)

notes.title: Release in less than 3 hours!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757802/2eb3bcb345b97d57ac893e0528ddb43ebc6b4caf.png[/img]

Wow! It is almost here! Less than 3 hours till the launch of "ERICANSKINSMONSTERS"! This is my first game I am releasing...ever, and it has been a journey! I have spent countless hours crafting Ericanskinsmonsters and I've played it constantly over the last few months along with testers to try and elevate the gameplay in anyway I could possibly fathom! I can honestly say I have played every aspect of this game many times and each time I find something new and exciting to add to enhance a scene or a fight mechanic. I hope you enjoy the story and gameplay if you do decide to play and, I wish you all a happy holiday season! 

Thank you once again for your love and support!

notes.title: One Month Out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757802/abef997a090a6084b53126930a48b26a73f062c0.jpg[/img]
Hello! 

I have been working hard scrubbing the game for bugs and any imperfections that I am able to fix before launch.  It has been good, but I noticed 1 more questline was needed to guide the player to some of the final content location, because it may not be clear. I have done my best to aid players as much as possible by providing tools such as the quest system which will tell you the direction/location within the quest log, interactive road signs to show town locations, and even added a mini map that will display the collision map in case you get lost in a maze. This game is long in the making and reflects a mixture of dark humor and pop-culture that ramble around in my brain. It is not suitable for all ages and has violence, adult language, minor 2-D blood, minor horror vibes with audio/music/jump scares. I made a lot of the music using a remix looping software and the game also features music from rpgmaker and Karugamo. I tried my best to set the tone and environment using as much as possible to deliver a solid game done by rpgmakermv.  It took me a while to learn and I think you can see the variety of features of the engine being showcased in a lot of different ways throughout the game. I made a lot of hidden content which range from(simple gold chest - what is a Notta Chicken?) Hey, don't ask me. Brad is the one who asked for it.  

Anywho, I may have down played the play time after watching a few other testers play, the game may be actually longer than 20-30 hours depending on your play style/experience/reading speed. I don't wanna brag, but I beat it in under 14. It is a story rich game and marked as such, but I wanted to make the combat fun, challenging, and exciting. As the game goes on, the combat difficulty and complexity will also increase. I posted a guide containing useful information and key bindings for PC/Xbox type controllers/Steam Deck on steam and I'll place it in the game file as well. Thank you for your time, and Game On!

notes.title: New Map Today! Plans to stream game on Steam Soon!
notes.content: I corrected a lot of dialog issues in this patch, added a large fire damage increase to a bunch of the undead(I'll recheck to see if I got all the ones I wanted) The biggest change noticeable is probably the minimap icon in the upper left which was requested and probably a good idea for people who need a little more help to not get lost. It's a basic map type that shows collision blocks/boundaries. Let me know what ya think. It is toggled zoom, by "Q" and I adjusted what I could to fit into the game. The map adjust with the size of the map you are currently on, so some maps will be much larger(my friend Brad said I've been typing map a lot the last couple days). I can have a switch to pull or something to toggle it completely off if you want but there are 2 events within the game that toggle it back on and you just have to toggle it back off and they should never happen again. It's late game....or I can just leave it on at all times if people think it's useful. Let me know! I look forward to streaming and playing through again shortly, but until then happy gaming and contact me if you have an idea of what I can fix or input to enhance the play of the game! Thank You!

notes.title: Large Audio and Scene Update
notes.content: Hello everyone who has been following this game, I just want to say thank you for your support; especially the testers who are aiding in the sculpting of this game! I am pushing this pretty large update after a week of spamming updates and thought you should know what is going on. I noticed a need for more audio variety and imported more audio into the game by Karugamo, as well as more updated audio from RPG Maker MV.  To go with the dark comedy feel of the game I have incorporating more dark vibes and I even tossed in some dialed down jump scares. Not making a horror game and don't need people spilling their coffee, but they might get ya lol. I'm working on more animations/abilities while trying to balance the combat system to give the team the most insane arsenal imaginable as they advance through their adventure, but everyone likes a challenge. The amazing art in this game is by 8 talented artist, RPG Maker MV, and as well as a couple masterpieces by yours truly! If you are blessed to happen upon them, beware! Haha. This is my first game release and hopefully I fumble through it gracefully with all of you. I look forward to feedback from testers on what they have found wrong and what I need, to make this game the epic story it should be! notes.title: Game Release Date Pushback
notes.content: Hello everyone my name is Eric and I'm the solo developer for SMIRKSMILEGRIN GAMES! This is notification of a pushback for the release of ERICANSKINSMONSTERS. I really haven't had much community involvement, but allow me to toss some information that may shed some light on this game. So why the game name? Well 8 years ago I met my wife and got her into gaming. The first game she really ever played on PC was Elder Scrolls Online. Until then she was playing Nintendo 64 in her studio.  Her first character she ever named in ESO was Ericanskinsmonsters and it has remained her main character for 8 years. She doesn't know why she came up with that name she just winged it and liked it. Since this was my first game I'd be releasing I thought why not start with a simpler engine and come up with a back story for the name Ericanskinsmonsters and make it an old school rpg. Well I have made a lot of random games in the past usually for my daughter's birthday or for fun, but this is my first actual game to release and I'm solo developing it. So why the release pushback? Well I set a goal that I thought was achievable, however due to changes to the game and personal choices, I'm unfortunately going to attempt a new launch around mid October. I've already added an additional 10 maps with more bosses/abilities/monsters to conquer which I believe was needed to tie my story together. Something just wasn't flowing but more additions will come and I'll be spending most of my time tweaking abilities and balancing the monsters in combat. I won't be revealing any new storyline besides what I already posted on steam. I'll be sending out beta keys to have a small test group to help me find bugs probably in August. If you are interested in helping during the beta then keep a lookout for an update on my YouTube. @SMIRKSMILEGRINGAMES  (I appreciate the support and I hope to make a very enjoyable RPG:)!
